title: Robert Lovett's memo to Truman leading to the CIA

tellings.quote: It was it was Robert Love it who actually wrote the initial memo to Truman saying we've got to we've got

plain: The CIA began with a memo to President Truman written by an official named Robert Lovett, according to Dan Sheehan, a researcher and lawyer who tells Michels about it without naming a source. As Sheehan puts it, Lovett wrote "the initial memo to Truman" urging that something had to be done, and it led to the agency. He tells it as part of his account of who shaped the secret side of government early on.
